        return x.sin() * 2
    return x.sin() * 2

backend_calls = []
def recording_backend(graph, inputs):
    backend_calls.append(graph.code)
    return graph.forward

    return x + 1

    torch.compile(helper, backend=recording_backend, dynamic=False)(torch.ones(4))
